bagPolicy.summary: All bags are searched. Small bags are permitted, but bags over 18 × 18 inches are prohibited and cannot be stored.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The staffed lot behind the building between 10th and 11th Streets and Nectarine and Buttonwood Streets opens at 6 p.m. and costs $20. Parking purchases are card only.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not specify a rideshare pickup or drop-off zone.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Lobby bars accept cash and card; outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The main floor, lobby bars and restrooms are accessible. Email the venue before the show to arrange special seating, as there is no fixed disabled seating section.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Once admitted, guests cannot leave and return. A designated outdoor smoking area is available for guests age 21 or older.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets can be picked up on show day beginning two hours before doors, typically 5 p.m., by the named purchaser with photo ID; will-call orders cannot be transferred.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Each event page gives a separate door and show start time. The box office at 1026 Spring Garden Street opens at 5 p.m. on show nights, and all bags are searched at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
